fields.Name: Integration Test: Conversation Authorship
fields.Description: Integration-test-only role for the conversation message authorship rules (who a message is from). Mirrors what the shipped UI role grants on the three entities a shared conversation touches: full Create/Read/Update/Delete on 'MJ: Conversations', 'MJ: Conversation Details' and 'MJ: Resource Permissions', with no row filter. Full CRUD on 'MJ: Conversation Details' is deliberate: it means every refusal the conversation-authorship-client bundle sees comes from the server's authorship rules, never from the role. Safe to delete; assign only to the seeded it-authorship-* test accounts.
